scenes.description:
A lone traveler, a blade with a dark past, and one answer that says everything.
Watch it till the last line. A real movie scene — no filters, no voiceover.
scenes.attribution: Footage: "Sintel" (2010) by Blender Foundation (durian.blender.org), licensed CC-BY 3.0

subs.text: This blade has a dark past.
It has shed much innocent blood.
You're a fool for traveling alone, so completely unprepared.
You're lucky your blood's still flowing.
What brings you to the land of the gatekeepers?
Someone very dear? A kindred spirit?
A dangerous quest for a lone hunter.
I've been alone for as long as I can remember.
